name: Pregnancy loss support
summary: Tender, trauma-informed support before, during and after a loss.
description: Gentle, trauma-informed doula support in Bend and Central Oregon for miscarriage, stillbirth and TFMR. In person or virtual. Sliding scale available.
intro: I offer tender, trauma-informed support for individuals, surrogates, intended parents and families experiencing pregnancy loss at any stage, including miscarriage, stillbirth and termination for medical reasons.
Whether your loss was expected or sudden, early or late, you deserve to be met with care and understanding. You do not have to move through this alone.

includes.title: A safe space
includes.text: Somewhere to talk through what you are experiencing, without judgment.

includes.title: Understanding your options
includes.text: Information on what to expect and help communicating with providers.

includes.title: Presence during care
includes.text: Emotional support during procedures, induction or delivery if you want it.

includes.title: After a loss
includes.text: Follow-up when you are ready, support for grief, and ideas for remembrance.

includes.title: Referrals
includes.text: Connections to grief therapists, specialists and peer support.

groups.heading: Before, during and after a loss
items: A safe, nonjudgmental space to talk through your experience
Guidance on your options for managing miscarriage or stillbirth
Support navigating medical systems, appointments and providers
Advocacy so your voice and needs are respected
Emotional support during procedures, induction or delivery if you want it
Comfort techniques for pain, anxiety and overwhelm
Referrals to grief therapists, loss specialists and peer support

groups.heading: After a loss
items: Follow-up within 24 to 72 hours, or when you are ready
What to expect physically after miscarriage or stillbirth
Support for processing grief, guilt, relief, confusion or numbness
Guidance on rituals, memory-making and honoring your baby
Resources for partners, family or children coping with loss

groups.heading: Additional support
items: Continued postpartum-style care, check-ins or home visits
Help with practical logistics such as memorial planning
Support in returning to daily life, work or future pregnancy planning
Referrals to trauma-informed therapy, support groups or spiritual care
